Name: bUsed
Comment: Feed wired for native tracking (PRG call)

Name: iDir
Comment: Belt travel sign (+1 / -1) from the feed config

Name: rOrgX
Comment: Belt CS origin X in world/MCS [mm] (feed origin = pick line center)

Name: rOrgY
Comment: Belt CS origin Y in world/MCS [mm]

Name: rOrgZ
Comment: Belt CS origin Z in world/MCS [mm] = rZBelt

Name: rPhi
Comment: Belt CS rotation in world [deg], x-axis along belt travel

Name: rZBelt
Comment: Belt surface height in world [mm] (item Z reference)
